subject: Monkey Maze Part 3
text: ASCII map of Monkey Maze Part 3 showing the start (O) and the exit (X).

evidence.quote: LEGEND FOR MONKEY MAZE PART #3

subject: Merlin (monkey)
text: The monkey Merlin teaches Mike the Psychic Shock Wave on a small mountain range at the northern edge of Monkey Maze Part 3.

evidence.quote: (Merlin?!?) will show you how to do a psychic shock wave

subject: Pyramid
text: Pyramid map legend: start at room 1, Pharaoh boss at room 25, exit to the overworld at room 26.

evidence.quote: LEGEND FOR PYRAMID ... 25 = BOSS: PHAROAH ... 26 = Leads to Overworld

subject: Pyramid Room 2 force field
text: The force field in Pyramid Room 2 can only be destroyed with the Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote: This force field requires the Psychic Shockwave to destroy.

subject: Pyramid Room 1
text: Jumping on the middle tile of the tile group to the left in Pyramid Room 1 reveals two hearts.

evidence.quote: jump on the middle tile in the ... two hearts will appear

subject: Pyramid Room 5
text: Pyramid Room 5 has two hearts on its north side.

evidence.quote: There are two hearts on the north side of the room

subject: Pyramid Room 5 question mark
text: Jumping on a tile in the top group reveals a question mark at the bottom of Pyramid Room 5, and grabbing it opens the East door.

evidence.quote: jump on one of the tiles to reveal the question mark at the bottom of the room ... once you grab the question mark the door to the East will open

subject: Pyramid Room 5 flame
text: In Pyramid Room 5, stop after passing the first flame, because going farther drops you to the floor with the asps.

evidence.quote: pass this first flame STOP. If you proceed any farther you will fall

subject: Pyramid Room 6 guardians
text: The pyramid guardians in Pyramid Room 6 are immune to the dagger and must be defeated with the Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote: your dagger so you will need to switch to your Psychic Shockwave

subject: Pyramid Room 7 chest
text: Pyramid Room 7 has a chest containing a medicine container, revealed by grabbing a question mark on a tile.

evidence.quote: Get this mark to open the chest and reveal a medicine

subject: Pyramid Room 9 false floors
text: Pyramid Room 9 has false floors among a circle of tiles that must be fallen through to reach Room 10.

evidence.quote: false floors which you need to fall ... ROOM #10.

subject: Pyramid Room 10
text: Pyramid Room 10 has two hearts in the bottom left corner.

evidence.quote: reach ROOM #10 without falling ... you will see a pair of two hearts in the bottom left corner

subject: Pyramid Room 11
text: Pyramid Room 11 has stairs in its upper right corner that lead up to Room 10.

evidence.quote: ROOM #11: ... Dispose of the them if you want to or just take the stairs in the upper right corner of the room to ROOM #10.

subject: Pyramid Room 14
text: Pyramid Room 14 contains a life sign.

evidence.quote: ROOM #14: ... There is also a life sign in here

subject: Pyramid Room 16 spiders
text: In Pyramid Room 16, ride the conveyor and defeat each spider on the ledges to open the North door to Room 17.

evidence.quote: ROOM #16: ... defeat each of the spiders on the ledges to open the door North to ROOM #17

subject: Pyramid Room 17
text: Jumping on a tile in the middle of Pyramid Room 17 reveals two hearts.

evidence.quote: ROOM #17: ... jump on a tile in the middle to reveal two hearts

subject: Pyramid Room 19 question mark
text: Jumping on the tail tile in Pyramid Room 19 reveals a question mark, and grabbing it opens the East door to Room 20.

evidence.quote: ROOM #19: ... Jump on the tail tile to reveal the question mark ... mark opens the door East to ROOM #20

subject: Pyramid Room 21 medicine tile
text: A tile at the top of Pyramid Room 21 makes a medicine appear when jumped on.

evidence.quote: ROOM #21: ... jump on to make a medicine appear

subject: Pyramid Room 22 chest
text: Pyramid Room 22 has a chest containing a flute, revealed by getting a question mark after activating a tile.

evidence.quote: ROOM #22: ... and get the question mark to reveal a flute from inside the chest

subject: Pyramid Room 22
text: Defeating the mini mummies in Pyramid Room 22 opens a wall to the West that leads back to Room 17.

evidence.quote: ROOM #22: ... defeat the mini mummies to open a wall to the ... West taking you back to ROOM #17

subject: Pyramid Room 19 flute asps
text: With the flute in Pyramid Room 19, summon three asps; defeating them opens the North wall to Room 23.

evidence.quote: ROOM #19 (Revisited): ... use a flute to make three asps appear ... to enter ROOM #23.

subject: Pyramid Room 24
text: Pyramid Room 24 has two hearts that can be collected if needed.

evidence.quote: ROOM #24: ... two hearts here is you want them

subject: Pyramid Room 24
text: Pyramid Room 24 has another medicine in the left corner of the room.

evidence.quote: ROOM #24: ... another medicine over on the left corner of the room

subject: Pharaoh
text: Pharaoh is the boss of Pyramid Room 25.

evidence.quote: ROOM #25: BOSS: PHAROAH

subject: Pharaoh
text: Defeating Pharaoh opens the door to the East, which leads to Room 26.

evidence.quote: Once you have defeated him a door will open to your East ... allowing you on to ROOM #26

subject: Pharaoh
text: Pharaoh mostly fires a spray of 5 bullets that are usually easy to avoid.

evidence.quote: This mask mostly shoots a spray of 5 bullets ... usually pretty easy to avoid

subject: Pharaoh
text: Pharaoh occasionally reveals a skeleton face and fires a more powerful shot that should be avoided.

evidence.quote: Occasionally the mask will reveal a skeleton face and shoot a more powerful shot so avoid those

subject: Pharaoh
text: As Pharaoh takes damage it moves faster and eventually turns red.

evidence.quote: As you damage the mask more and more it will move faster and eventually turn red.

subject: Tetrad
text: A room at the end of the long narrow tunnel north of Mike inside the Pyramid contains another Tetrad.

evidence.quote: Follow this until you enter a room with another Tetrad

subject: BIG HEART
text: A BIG HEART is in the sewer below the open manhole in London that Mike is directed to head left toward.

evidence.quote: There is a BIG HEART below that Mike could really use

subject: London manhole south
text: The manhole south of the open manhole leads down to the sewer dungeon.

evidence.quote: for the other manhole South of there ... Take this down to start the sewer dungeon

subject: Pyramid Room 10 landing
text: In Room 10, press your control pad to the left when you fall in.

evidence.quote: ROOM #10: ... As you fall into this room press your control pad to the left.
